summary:
Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) is a U.S.-based multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Its major medicines treat cancer, cardiovascular disease, autoimmune conditions, and blood disorders. In 2025, its largest revenue sources included Eliquis (30%) and Opdivo (21%); 69% of revenue came from the United States. The company ranked 94th on the Fortune 500 and 173rd on the Forbes Global 2000.

BMS traces its roots to two 19th-century businesses: Squibb, founded in 1858 and known for pharmaceutical quality standards, and Bristol-Myers, established in 1887. The companies merged in 1989. Over time, BMS shifted from a diversified business toward specialty biopharmaceuticals, focusing on medicines and biologic products. It operates research and development sites in the United States and several countries internationally.

The company expanded its drug pipeline through major acquisitions, including Celgene in 2019, MyoKardia in 2020, Turning Point Therapeutics in 2022, and Mirati Therapeutics, RayzeBio, and Karuna Therapeutics in 2024. These deals broadened its portfolios in cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neuroscience. In September 2024, the FDA approved Cobenfy, a new type of schizophrenia treatment.

BMS has also faced significant legal and business controversies. Settlements addressed allegations involving Taxol and generic BuSpar, as well as improper sales practices known as “channel stuffing.” The company was also named in a lawsuit concerning the Guatemala syphilis experiments, but was dismissed from the case in 2022.
unsupportedClaims: Bristol-Myers was established in 1887. The points say Bristol and Myers bought the existing Clinton Pharmaceutical Company that year and decided to rename it in 1898.
Squibb was known for its pharmaceutical quality standards. The points establish Edward Squibb's advocacy for those standards, not the company's reputation for them.
BMS completed the MyoKardia acquisition in 2020. The points date the announcement to 2020 but do not give a completion date.
The RayzeBio acquisition expanded BMS's drug pipeline. The points give the acquisition date and value but do not say what it added to the pipeline.
